mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 drops below 0.4 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as firms invest in productivity-enhancing technologies.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the labor market participation rate (not directly proxied) drops significantly (below 62%) over any 9-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105, combined with a rise in real GDP (GDPC1), signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and GDPC1 drops below 0.5 over any 15-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in optimization periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 680 million, coupled with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE), indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the consumer sentiment index (not directly proxied) drops significantly (below 90) over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rising above 5.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 indicates labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the labor market conditions index (not directly proxied) drops significantly (below -2) over any 9-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 108, without a corresponding rise in GDP (GDPC1), signals supply chain inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and GDPC1 remains above 0.6 over any 18-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in disruption periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
